source.title: Forum Digest (July 2021)
source.content:
Starting last year, the WCA Forum was designed for community members to give their insight on actions within the WCA. We have had over 10,000 members and more than 4,000 unique posts since which covered discussions on new WCA proposals and existing WCA policies. In this bi-monthly digest, we have summarized some interesting topics on the Forum in the last couple of months. Feel free to view the threads below at your leisure.
<!-- break -->
[**Ruihang Xu’s 5.48 3x3 Average**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/wr-ruihang-xu-3x3-average-5-48/14112)
Ruihang Xu swept the world by breaking an incredible amount of records this year and finally grabbing the 3x3 average world record from Feliks Zemdegs. This is a monumental achievement for the Chinese community and speedcubing as a whole, being the first average under 5.50 seconds.

[**Impact of the year 2020 on the cubing community**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/impact-of-the-year-2020-on-the-cubing-community/10136)
The years 2020 and 2021 saw a big slump in the number of WCA competitions due to the COVID-19 pandemic. This thread saw discussions on how regular WCA competitors are coping when there are no competitions to attend.

[**WCA Championship 2023 Hosts Announcement**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/wca-championship-2022-and-2023-hosts-announcement-june-2021/14418)
The city of Seoul in the Republic of Korea was selected by a selection committee to host WCA World Championship 2023. After 12 years, Worlds will finally return to Asia. In a month's time, the registration for World Championship 2021 will open up which will take place in Almere, Netherlands. Keep an eye out for that news as well!

[**Changes in 2021 Regulations**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/asking-for-feedback-for-2021-regulations/12311)
The yearly WCA regulations update was done by the WCA Regulations Committee. Feedback and suggestions are taken from this WCA Forum thread for consideration by the committee. More details of the changes can be viewed on the WCA Github here.

[**Return of Cubing Competitions in the US**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/return-of-cubing-competitions-in-the-us/13926)
The biggest country for cubing is finally resuming WCA competitions. After the COVID-19 pandemic caused a break for over a year, the US is starting to organize competitions again.

If you have any questions, comments, or feedback, please send an email to [advisory@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:advisory@worldcubeassociation.org) or participate in the discussions on the threads yourself!

Thanks to everyone for being a part of the Forum by sharing important feedback and adding value to the discussions.

translation.title: WCA 论坛精选（2021 年 7 月）
translation.content:
WCA 论坛于去年启用，旨在让社区成员就 WCA 的工作发表意见。至今已有超过 10,000 名成员，发布了 4,000 多篇不同帖子，讨论新提案和现有政策。在这期双月简报中，我们整理了过去几个月里一些有意思的话题，欢迎大家有空时阅读。

[**许瑞航的三阶平均 5.48 秒**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/wr-ruihang-xu-3x3-average-5-48/14112)
许瑞航今年接连打破多项纪录，最终从 Feliks Zemdegs 手中拿下三阶平均世界纪录，引起了世界魔方圈的关注。这是首个低于 5.50 秒的平均成绩，对中国魔方社区乃至整个速拧运动都有重要意义。

[**2020 年对魔方社区的影响**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/impact-of-the-year-2020-on-the-cubing-community/10136)
受新冠疫情影响，2020 年和 2021 年的 WCA 比赛数量大幅下降。这篇帖子讨论了经常参赛的魔友在没有比赛的日子里如何度过。

[**2023 年 WCA 世锦赛举办地公告**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/wca-championship-2022-and-2023-hosts-announcement-june-2021/14418)
遴选委员会选定韩国首尔举办 2023 年 WCA 世锦赛。时隔 12 年，世锦赛终于将重返亚洲。再过一个月，计划在荷兰阿尔梅勒举行的 2021 年世锦赛也将开放报名，请留意相关消息！

[**2021 年规则修改**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/asking-for-feedback-for-2021-regulations/12311)
WCA 规则委员会完成了年度规则更新。委员会从这篇 WCA 论坛帖子中收集反馈和建议，供修订时参考。具体修改可在 WCA GitHub 上查看。

[**美国恢复魔方比赛**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/return-of-cubing-competitions-in-the-us/13926)
魔方比赛规模最大的国家终于恢复举办 WCA 比赛。新冠疫情导致赛事停摆一年多后，美国开始重新组织比赛。

如有问题、意见或建议，请发送邮件至 [advisory@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:advisory@worldcubeassociation.org)，或直接参与帖子讨论！

感谢每一位论坛参与者，感谢大家分享重要反馈、为讨论补充有价值的意见。
notes: 原文“WCA Github here”未附超链接，译文不猜补。世锦赛报名与举办地信息按本公告发布时内容保留。
